title: Build Quality and Expectations
summary: Reviews in this topic center on whether build, finish, and repair experiences meet expected BMW standards, but many fragments are too brief or context-limited to determine sentiment clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car's solid build and premium finish as meeting expected BMW quality.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe rattles, an early breakdown, and a lengthy repair experience as falling below expectations for a new BMW.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention expectations, finish, service, or repairs, but the short excerpts often lack enough context to classify them confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confidence in a more specific thematic summary.
The cluster mixes vehicle build and finish comments with service and repair-related remarks rather than one single tightly focused subject.
Several excerpts are very short or incomplete, so their sentiment and exact context cannot be resolved from the fragment alone.
